data_availability.summary: Dubai Calendar exposes no public API: dubaicalendar.ae redirects into bot-protected visitdubai.com (Akamai returns 403 to non-browser clients), and the only official events dataset (slug dtcm_e_permits_events-open-api, now served from the apis.data.dubai gateway after the Dubai Pulse portal was decommissioned) requires OAuth credentials. This pack therefore stays curated.

This replaces the position on 2026-10-20, when the page showed no cash prize, and the USD 200,000 pool recorded before that. The competition has not been held yet (finals 10 December 2026), so no winner or payout is recorded.

supernova_format.selection_note: Per the official page on 2026-11-26: 20 startups per stage pitch in the semi-finals (Pre-Seed and Seed on 8 December, Series A on 9 December), and 3 startups from each stage (9 in total) go through to the finals on 10 December, held with the award ceremony. The page on 2026-10-20 showed no separate final round.
supernova_format.entry_requirement: Only exhibiting startups at Expand North Star 2026 can apply: register as an exhibitor, then submit the application form, pitch deck and elevator pitch video through the Exhibitor Portal (Ezone).

outcomes.dubai_yoga: Still to come on 29 November 2026 at DIFC, free to attend, per the 22 November Dubai Media Office release.

events.notes: 10th edition, running to 29 November 2026. Dubai Ride (4 km family and 12 km routes) opened the challenge on Sheikh Zayed Road on 1 November 2026, Dubai Stand-Up Paddle was scheduled at Hatta Dam on 7 and 8 November, Dubai Run (5 km and 10 km) took over Sheikh Zayed Road on 22 November and Dubai Yoga (second edition) closes the programme on 29 November at DIFC. events.name: Dubai Shopping Festival 2026-27
events.notes: 32nd edition, 4 December 2026 to 17 January 2027 (45 days), starting after the Eid Al Etihad holiday. The Visit Dubai DSF page shows these dates and the DFRE release (distributed via Zawya, press coverage dated 14 October 2026) confirms the edition and length. Returning features named in the release include etisalat DSF Nights, DSF x Hatta Wadi Hub, DSF Auto Season and etisalat MOTB in January; a release published on 10 November 2026 (read as carried by Emirates 24|7, secondary) restates the 4 December opening and adds a candlelight concert at DSF x Hatta Wadi Hub on 2 December 2026 for Eid Al Etihad, ahead of the official opening. A full sub-event calendar and the raffle schedule were not found as of 26 November 2026.

last_refresh_scope: Targeted refresh of 2026-11-26: news since 2026-10-20 only. Supernova 0X (official page): now advertises USD 115,000 in equity-free cash prizes (USD 20,000 Pre-Seed, USD 30,000 Seed, USD 65,000 Series A), so prize_pool_usd is 115000 again (it was null on 2026-10-20); the final application deadline moved to 23 November 2026 and has passed (applications now closed); a finals round on 10 December is now listed (3 startups per stage). Expand North Star (8 to 10 December) and GITEX Global (summit 7 December at DWTC, expo 8 to 11 December at Expo City) have not taken place yet and are unchanged on the organiser sites; no Supernova winner exists yet and gitex.com gives no GITEX Global 2027 dates. Marked as passed, in the pack's existing status style: Dubai FinTech Summit (held, per the organiser site thank-you notice; no 2027 dates), Dubai AI Festival, WETEX, World Green Economy Summit, Dubai Festival of Lights and Dubai Future Week (dates_passed, no outcome figures read) and Dubai Home Festival (ended). Dubai Future Week 2027 added from the organiser site: 17 to 21 November 2027, Emirates Towers and the Museum of the Future. Dubai Fitness Challenge (in progress to 29 November): Dubai Run drew more than 310,000 runners on 22 November per Dubai Media Office; Dubai Ride drew 41,836 cyclists per The National citing Dubai Media Office (secondary); Dubai Yoga is on 29 November at DIFC. Dubai Shopping Festival: 4 December 2026 to 17 January 2027 unchanged; a 2 December candlelight concert at Hatta Wadi Hub added from a 10 November release read via Emirates 24|7 (secondary). Checked with no change on organiser sites: STEP Dubai 2027 (3 to 4 February), AIM Congress 2027 (12 to 14 April), Dubai Airshow 2027 (15 to 19 November), UN 2026 Water Conference (8 to 10 December, ADNEC), Gulfood 2027 (15 to 19 March). Unverified: outcomes of WETEX, WGES, Dubai AI Festival, Dubai Home Festival, Dubai Festival of Lights and Dubai Future Week (organiser sites blocked or without a report; WAM pages could not be read); Dubai Stand-Up Paddle outcome; WGS 2027 venue; Dubai FinTech Summit 2027, Dubai AI Week 2027, GITEX Global 2027 and WETEX 2027 dates (none announced on the sources read); DSF sub-event and raffle dates. All pack URLs were link-checked: visitdubai.com, dubaidet.gov.ae, wetex.ae, dewa.gov.ae and dubaifitnesschallenge.com still return HTTP 403 (bot blocking, kept) and apis.data.dubai returns 401 (OAuth, expected); no dead links.
